tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page canvas and the ground behind panes. Text on it: text, muted, faint (all pass 4.5:1). Source: studio-app tokens.css --bg.

tokens.name: rail
tokens.usage: Left navigation rail ground. Text on it: text, muted.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Pane, card and chart surface, one step above bg. Text on it: text, muted, faint.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Hover wash on rows, tabs and buttons; also the stripe in the empty-state hatch.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: Selected row, progress-bar track. Text on it: text, muted.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline between rows inside a pane or table. Solid grey in direction H.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Pane and button outline, tab-list underline, toolbar rule.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text, values, and the inverted primary-button fill. On bg, raised, rail, hover, selected.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, descriptions, hints. On bg, raised, rail, hover, selected.

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary text and disabled controls (disabled also gets a dashed border). On bg, raised, rail.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Direction H: white as TEXT: failure words, tab badges, selected marks. State only; there is no orange any more. On bg, raised.

tokens.name: signal-graphic
tokens.usage: Direction H: white as a MARK (lines, glyph fills, verdict left rule). Needs 3:1.

tokens.name: stroke
tokens.usage: Chart axis and glyph strokes that carry meaning. Needs 3:1 on bg and raised.

tokens.name: grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines. Decorative, no contrast requirement.

tokens.name: notice-error-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of the inline error notice.

tokens.name: ramp-0
tokens.usage: Low end of the lineage score ramp (lowest score).

tokens.name: ramp-1
tokens.usage: High end of the lineage score ramp (best score).

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Sign role colour on focal numbers only (value text, never a fill) and legacy success mark. sign-negative under the default red-up convention, sign-positive under green-up (a Settings switch). Always paired with a leading + or minus glyph. On bg, raised.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Legacy analysis-page state colour: caution. Same restriction as ok.

tokens.name: err
tokens.usage: Sign role colour on focal numbers only (value text, never a fill) and legacy error text. sign-positive under the default red-up convention, sign-negative under green-up (a Settings switch). Always paired with a leading + or minus glyph. On bg, raised.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Alias for tools that need a primary colour: the primary action is the white `contrast` fill with `on-contrast` text and one 8px chamfer.

tokens.name: contrast
tokens.usage: White-on-black primary surface: the primary button face, the tag square, the logo tile, the verdict state tile. Pair with `on-contrast`.

tokens.name: on-contrast
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on a `contrast` surface.

tokens.name: bar
tokens.usage: Section header bar ground (Endfield style), with the hatch strip at its right end. Text on it: `bar-text`.

tokens.name: bar-text
tokens.usage: Text on a section bar.

tokens.name: verdict-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of the focal verdict block.

tokens.name: up
tokens.usage: Sign colour, red up, on focal numbers only (option C). With the Settings switch on green-up it is the negative colour.

tokens.name: dn
tokens.usage: Sign colour, green down, on focal numbers only (option C).

families.sans: 'Noto Sans SC Variable', 'Noto Sans SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', system-ui, sans-serif
families.mono: '0xProto', 'Noto Sans SC Variable', 'Microsoft YaHei', ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace
families.heading: 'Smiley Sans', 'Noto Sans SC Variable', 'Noto Sans SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', system-ui, sans-serif
families.display: '0xProto', 'Noto Sans SC Variable', 'Microsoft YaHei', ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace

type.rules: Direction H (owner, 2026-11-04) on top of direction B's scale. Chinese headings Smiley Sans (one weight, 400), body Noto Sans SC, every Latin label, number and id 0xProto (display and mono share it; each role is one token). Nothing renders below 10px (the micro-label). Numbers and ids are always tabular. Micro-labels are uppercase, 0.16em tracked, and sit beside the Chinese label, never replacing it.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: The page header title: the one anchor of hierarchy on every page.

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Section and pane headings, the verdict word of an answer strip. One line-strong rule sits under a section heading.

styles.name: verdict
styles.usage: The verdict word inside the verdict block.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default text: evidence sentences, form text, table text.
styles.sample: The mean rank IC clears the noise frontier.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Secondary lines and captions: the split/state line under a library row name, status lines, hints.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Column headers, metadata keys, chip text; muted. The smallest size anywhere.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Uppercase tracked micro-label beside a Chinese label (VERDICT, NET SHARPE, METRICS / VALID). Never replaces the Chinese label.

styles.name: value
styles.usage: Numbers in tables and metric grids, right-aligned, tabular. A library row's focal metric uses value at weight 600.

styles.name: value-lg
styles.usage: A library row headline metric and the neighbouring numbers of the verdict block.

styles.name: value-focal
styles.usage: The focal number of the verdict block (net Sharpe), 0xProto, counts up once on first paint.

spacing.rules: Only 4 / 8 / 12 / 16 / 24 / 32. 1px is a hairline, not spacing.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Inside a cell; between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between items of one group (buttons in a toolbar, chips in a row).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between rows of a group; pane padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a section.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page top and bottom, where there is room.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Direction H: square. Controls and pane edges have no radius.

tokens.name: radius-float
tokens.usage: Direction H: square. Menus, popovers and dialogs have no radius.

tokens.name: chamfer
tokens.usage: One 45-degree corner cut (top-right) on the primary button, the verdict block, a card corner and the selected navigation marker only.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Minimum height of a button in a dense action row.

tokens.name: pane-head-height
tokens.usage: Minimum height of a pane head row (tabs and actions).

tokens.name: page-max-width
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the workbench shell; content is centred beyond it.

tokens.name: pane-left-min
tokens.usage: Minimum width of the left (editor) pane; columns default to 40fr / 60fr.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline between rows of a list, table or key/value table.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: One rule under a section heading or toolbar; the outer border of a surface that must separate from the ground (pane, popover, dialog).

lines.rules: No border around a group that already sits in a pane; no box in a box. Chips inside a pane are text, not outlined boxes.
